# ShortReal AI

> A harnessed AI-powered video generation studio. Just bring the idea, and create videos with identical characters and high-end visuals in minutes.

## Core Features
- **Harnessed Video Generation Pipeline**: We integrate and manage complex AI models and pipelines so you don't have to.
- **Identical Characters**: Generate videos keeping characters identical across multiple scenes.
- **High-end Visuals in Minutes**: Generate stunning shortforms and videos from simple text ideas.
